inspo: Yuji Itadori; Black Flash, Divergent Fist
desc: A body built to hold something that should have killed it. Tough beyond reason, quick to recover, and always a little hungry.

effects.name: Iron Gut
effects.text: Rotten flesh, raw meat and spider eyes never poison you.

effects.name: Second Wind
effects.text: Below 25% health, gain Speed I (once a minute).

abilities.name: Superhuman Leap
abilities.text: Jump 6 blocks high with no fall damage. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Sprint Burst
abilities.text: Speed III for 4 s. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Shrug Off
abilities.text: Remove every harmful effect and heal 4. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Brute Carry
abilities.text: Pick up a downed ally or a block entity and carry it for 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Wall Kick
abilities.text: Kick off a wall you're touching for a second jump. 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Unbreakable
abilities.text: For 6 s you can't drop below 1 health. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Heavy Lift
abilities.text: Throw the block you look at (not bedrock or containers) 8 blocks as a falling block. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Deep Breath
abilities.text: Hold your breath 3x longer and swim 30% faster for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Bracing Shout
abilities.text: You and allies within 8 get Resistance I for 8 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Never Quit
abilities.text: If you'd die, stand back up 3 s later with 4 health (once every 30 minutes).

abilities.name: Divergent Fist
abilities.text: Your next punch hits twice: on contact and as an echo 0.5 s later. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Black Flash
abilities.text: Your next hit within 5 s deals 2.5x damage with black sparks. 90 s cooldown.

inspo: Mahito, Jogo, Hanami; Idle Transfiguration, Soul Punch
desc: Condensed out of human fear rather than born. Hard to see, harder to kill, and fed by the dread of everything around them.

effects.name: Faded
effects.text: Mobs notice you at half the usual distance.

effects.name: Shadow Mend
effects.text: Regenerate 1 health every 4 s while in darkness (light below 7).

effects.name: Dread Aura
effects.text: Hostile mobs below 6 health won't attack you.

abilities.name: Unseen
abilities.text: Become invisible to mobs for 15 s; it ends when you attack. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Phase Through
abilities.text: Walk through one block-thick walls for 4 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.text: Watch a marked block from anywhere in the world for 10 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Body Reshape
abilities.text: Shrink to half size for 30 s to fit through small gaps. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Panic
abilities.text: Villagers and animals within 12 blocks flee; you heal 1 for each, up to 6. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lurk
abilities.text: Become invisible while still in darkness for 60 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Dread Sense
abilities.text: See every living creature within 32 blocks through walls for 8 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Reform
abilities.text: When you'd die, reform at 4 health 2 blocks away instead (once every 20 minutes).

abilities.name: Possess Beast
abilities.text: Take control of an animal you look at for 20 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Spawn Curse
abilities.text: Leave a small curse ally that fights for you for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Soul Punch
abilities.text: Your next hit ignores armour and gives Slowness III for 3 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Twist Soul
abilities.text: Grab the enemy you look at (6 blocks): it's rooted and takes 2 damage a second for 3 s. 60 s cooldown.

inspo: Toji and Maki Zen'in; Inventory Curse, Blitz, Killing Slash
desc: Born with no cursed energy and paid back in flesh: senses, speed and strength no sorcerer can match. They carry their arsenal in a curse coiled around their waist.

effects.name: Light Feet
effects.text: Take no fall damage from falls up to 8 blocks.

effects.name: Sharp Ears
effects.text: Mobs sneaking up within 8 blocks glow.

abilities.name: Weapon Pocket
abilities.text: Open a 9-slot pocket that only holds weapons and tools. 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Keen Senses
abilities.text: See every creature within 32 blocks through walls for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Wall Run
abilities.text: Run along walls for 3 s. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Silent Step
abilities.text: Your steps make no sound for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hunter's Nose
abilities.text: Point to the player or mob type you name for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Weapon Catch
abilities.text: Catch the next arrow or thrown weapon that hits you within 5 s. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Climb
abilities.text: Climb any wall like a ladder for 10 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Field Dressing
abilities.text: Heal 6 over 3 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Spell Ward
abilities.text: For 10 s, spell zones and area spells don't affect you. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fast Hands
abilities.text: Swap, eat and drink twice as fast for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Blitz
abilities.text: Dash 10 blocks, hitting the first enemy for your weapon's damage. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Killing Slash
abilities.text: A wide slash that hits every enemy in front within 4 blocks for 150% weapon damage. 60 s cooldown.

inspo: Choso, Noritoshi Kamo; Piercing Blood, Supernova, Blood Meteorite, Flowing Red Scale
desc: Half-human, half-curse, with blood that obeys them. They spend their own health as a weapon and get it back faster than anyone.

effects.name: Blood Regen
effects.text: Heal 1 every 5 s while above half hunger.

effects.name: Blood Sense
effects.text: Wounded creatures (below half health) within 16 blocks glow.

effects.name: Haemorrhage
effects.text: Your melee hits make targets bleed for 1 damage a second for 2 s.

effects.name: Blood Price
effects.text: Abilities that cost health cost 25% less.

abilities.name: Flowing Red Scale
abilities.text: Speed I, Strength I and Haste I for 20 s, costing 4 health. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Coagulate
abilities.text: Stop bleeding on you and allies within 6, healing each 4. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Bridge
abilities.text: Harden blood into a 6-block bridge ahead for 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Pact
abilities.text: Give 4 of your health to an ally you look at. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Trail
abilities.text: Leave a glowing trail for 3 minutes you can follow back. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Supernova Landing
abilities.text: Burst blood under you to stop a fall. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Brother's Bond
abilities.text: Mark an ally: you always know where they are and when they're hurt, for 20 minutes. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Red Rain
abilities.text: Allies within 8 get Regeneration I for 8 s, costing you 4 health. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Lock
abilities.text: Seal a door or chest with blood: only you can open it, for 20 minutes. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Hemo Sight
abilities.text: See every creature's health within 24 blocks for 20 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Piercing Blood
abilities.text: A compressed blood beam in a 20-block line, 8 damage, costing 2 health. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blood Meteorite
abilities.text: Throw a hardened blood ball that homes in and bursts for 6 damage in 3 blocks. 90 s cooldown.

desc: A stitched or built body run by a core instead of a heart. Some carry spare cores; some carry entire workshops in their limbs.

effects.name: Spare Core
effects.text: Once every 20 minutes, a fatal hit leaves you at 4 health.

effects.name: Wool Mend
effects.text: Using wool or string heals 2 (10 s cooldown).

abilities.name: Core Swap
abilities.text: Switch cores: one gives Speed I, the other Resistance I. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Stitch Up
abilities.text: Heal 6 using string or wool. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Rolling
abilities.text: Curl up and roll 10 blocks forward, immune to knockback. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Thrusters
abilities.text: Fly upward for 3 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Remote Eye
abilities.text: Send a tiny drone up to 32 blocks to scout for 15 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Built-in Tools
abilities.text: Your arm becomes an iron pickaxe, axe or shovel for 60 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Puppet Friend
abilities.text: Sew a small puppet that follows you and carries 9 items for 10 minutes. 15 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Searchlight
abilities.text: Light the way 24 blocks ahead for 60 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Defence Mode
abilities.text: Resistance II for 6 s, but you can't move. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Cuddle
abilities.text: Hug an ally: both heal 1 a second for 5 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Drumming Beat
abilities.text: Your next hit ignores armour and knocks back hard. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Ultra Cannon
abilities.text: Charge 2 s and fire a 16-block beam for 10 damage. 90 s cooldown.

inspo: Jogo; Disaster Flames, Flame Pillar, Maximum Meteor, Lava Hand, Coffin of the Iron Mountain
desc: Curses born from the fear of the earth's fire. Lava is a warm bath, the ground smokes under their feet, and water is their only real enemy.

effects.name: Fireproof
effects.text: Immune to fire damage (lava still hurts).

effects.name: Lava Swimmer
effects.text: Swim in lava at normal speed.

effects.name: Ember Skin
effects.text: Attackers that hit you in melee catch fire for 2 s.

effects.name: Heat Haze
effects.text: Nether biomes give you Speed I.

effects.name: Cinder Mend
effects.text: Standing in fire or near lava (4 blocks) heals 1 every 3 s.

effects.name: Sun Fed
effects.text: Hunger drains 25% slower in the day.

abilities.name: Lava Walk
abilities.text: Walk on lava for 10 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Lava Hand
abilities.text: Turn the stone you touch into magma or lava, or lava into obsidian. 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Hearth
abilities.text: Light a fire anywhere that heals allies 1 every 3 s for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Smelt
abilities.text: Smelt the ores in your inventory. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Volcanic Vent
abilities.text: Launch yourself 10 blocks up on a burst of smoke. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Heat Sense
abilities.text: See every warm-blooded creature within 24 blocks through walls for 8 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Clear Skies
abilities.text: Stop rain in your area. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fire Ward
abilities.text: You and allies within 6 are immune to fire for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Ember Light
abilities.text: Float an ember that lights your way for 2 minutes. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Coffin Shelter
abilities.text: Raise a dome of stone around you for 20 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Flame Pillar
abilities.text: A pillar of fire bursts from the ground at the spot you look at, 8 damage. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Maximum Meteor
abilities.text: Drop a meteor on the spot you look at: 12 damage in 5 blocks. 5 min cooldown.

inspo: Satoru Gojo; Infinity, Lapse Blue, Reversal Red, Hollow Purple
desc: Born with eyes that see energy down to the atom. Space bends a little around them: things fall toward them, or never quite reach them.

effects.name: Mana Sight
effects.text: See every mob's health within 16 blocks.

effects.name: Near Infinity
effects.text: Projectiles deal 15% less damage to you.

effects.name: Spatial Sense
effects.text: Mobs that would hit you from behind glow 1 s before.

abilities.name: Infinity
abilities.text: For 3 s nothing touches you: attacks and projectiles stop just short. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.text: Teleport to the block you look at (12 blocks). 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Float
abilities.text: Hover in place for 6 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Blindfold
abilities.text: See every living thing within 24 blocks through walls for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Pull Items
abilities.text: Pull every dropped item within 16 blocks to you. 15 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Detached
abilities.text: Walk on air for 4 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Insight
abilities.text: See hidden blocks (traps, chests, spawners) within 16 blocks for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Read
abilities.text: Look at a creature: learn its health, armour and resistances. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Spell Echo
abilities.text: Repeat the last spell you cast at half power, free. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Unlimited Calm
abilities.text: Your next 3 spells cost no mana. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lapse: Blue
abilities.text: Pull every enemy within 8 blocks of the spot you look at into its centre. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Reversal: Red
abilities.text: Blast every enemy within 6 blocks away for 6 damage. 60 s cooldown.

inspo: Ryomen Sukuna; Cleave, Dismantle, Fuga, Shrine
desc: Descended from the four-armed demon of the Heian era. Two faces, four arms, and a hunger for everything that walks.

effects.name: Four Arms
effects.text: Your offhand works as a full main hand for tools.

effects.name: Rear Face
effects.text: Mobs behind you within 8 blocks glow.

effects.name: Gourmand
effects.text: Eat raw and rotten food safely, with 20% more food from it.

effects.name: King's Weight
effects.text: Mobs with less than half your max health won't approach unless you attack.

effects.name: Contempt
effects.text: Slowness and weakness last half as long on you.

abilities.name: Shrine
abilities.text: Place a shrine for 5 minutes: no mobs spawn within 12 blocks. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Four-Arm Work
abilities.text: Break blocks and craft twice as fast for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rear Gaze
abilities.text: Everything behind you glows for 30 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Feast Sense
abilities.text: Sense every animal and cooked food within 32 blocks for 10 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Contempt
abilities.text: Ignore all slowness and weakness for 30 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Second Mouth
abilities.text: Your next spell casts instantly. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Butcher
abilities.text: Animals you kill drop double meat for 60 s. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Cut Through
abilities.text: Slash a 3x3 hole through wood, leaves and soft blocks ahead. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Royal Fear
abilities.text: Hostile mobs below 20 health flee from you for 6 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fuga Torch
abilities.text: Light every torch, campfire and candle within 12 blocks. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Dismantle
abilities.text: An invisible slash in a 6-block line, 7 damage. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Your next hit deals 8% of the target's max health extra. 60 s cooldown.

inspo: Megumi Fushiguro and the Ten Shadows
desc: Heirs who draw animal spirits out of shadow. Their shadow is a door, a pocket and a kennel.

effects.name: Shadow Pocket
effects.text: 9 extra storage slots, only while in light below 8.

effects.name: Pack Bond
effects.text: Your pets and summons take 15% less damage.

effects.name: Quiet
effects.text: Mobs hear you at half distance in the dark.

effects.name: Shadow Step
effects.text: Sneaking in darkness makes you invisible to mobs after 2 s.

abilities.name: Divine Dogs
abilities.text: Two shadow dogs track and fight for you for 60 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Toad
abilities.text: A toad pulls you or an item to you with its tongue (16 blocks). 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Nue
abilities.text: A great owl carries you through the air for 8 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Sink
abilities.text: Sink into your shadow and move through the ground for 5 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Max Elephant
abilities.text: Flood a 6-block area with water for 10 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Round Deer
abilities.text: Heal you and allies within 6 for 1 a second for 6 s. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rabbit Escape
abilities.text: Shadow rabbits hide you: mobs lose your target, invisible 3 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Garden
abilities.text: Fill 5 blocks with shadow for 10 s; sink and resurface anywhere in it. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Piercing Ox
abilities.text: An ox charges 12 blocks ahead, breaking soft blocks. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Shadow Stash
abilities.text: Store a whole stack in your shadow and take it out anywhere. 10 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Great Serpent
abilities.text: A serpent rises under the enemy you look at and holds it for 2 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Chimera Shadow
abilities.text: Merge your shikigami into you for 10 s: Speed II and Strength I. 5 min cooldown.

inspo: Kinji Hakari; Idle Death Gamble, Pachinko Ball, Jackpot
desc: Their power runs on luck. When the reels line up they're unstoppable; when they don't, they keep spinning.

effects.name: Fever
effects.text: After a kill, +10% speed for 5 s.

effects.name: Big Win
effects.text: Ores have a 5% chance to drop double.

effects.name: Loaded Dice
effects.text: Your random rolls (crits, drops) get one reroll a minute.

effects.name: Never Bust
effects.text: Once every 30 minutes, a fatal hit misses instead.

effects.name: Comp Meals
effects.text: Food has a 10% chance not to be used up.

abilities.name: Spin the Reels
abilities.text: A random buff (Speed, Strength, Regeneration, Haste or Luck II) for 60 s. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Jackpot
abilities.text: 1 in 4 chance: for 30 s, heal instantly from any damage. 5 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Double or Nothing
abilities.text: Bet a stack: 50% to double it, 50% to lose it. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Lucky Dig
abilities.text: Next 20 ores have a 30% chance of double drops. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Pachinko Balls
abilities.text: Drop balls that make mobs slip and fall for 5 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Coin Flip
abilities.text: Heads: blink 8 blocks back. Tails: 8 forward. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Reroll
abilities.text: Reset the cooldown of one other race ability. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Fever Mode
abilities.text: For 20 s, abilities have a 50% chance to skip their cooldown. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Hot Streak
abilities.text: Each kill within 60 s adds 5% damage, up to 25%. 3 min cooldown.

abilities.name: House Edge
abilities.text: Trades have a 25% chance of a double result for 5 minutes. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Rough Energy
abilities.text: A spray of rough energy: 4 damage and knockback. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Lucky Shot
abilities.text: Your next attack is a guaranteed crit with 50% more damage. 45 s cooldown.

inspo: Yuki Tsukumo; Star Rage, Garuda, Black Hole, Saturn
desc: They can give their body imaginary mass. Light as a feather one moment, heavy as a falling star the next.

effects.name: Heavy
effects.text: Immune to knockback while standing still.

effects.name: Momentum
effects.text: Sprinting builds up to +20% melee damage over 3 s.

effects.name: Anchor
effects.text: Water currents and pistons don't move you.

effects.name: Orbit
effects.text: Dropped items within 4 blocks drift to you.

effects.name: Impact
effects.text: Falling more than 4 blocks onto enemies damages them.

abilities.name: Featherweight
abilities.text: Become weightless for 6 s: jump 4 blocks, fall slowly. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Heavyweight
abilities.text: For 10 s, you can't be moved and you sink in water. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Garuda
abilities.text: A shikigami that carries 27 items and follows you for 5 minutes. 10 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Orbit Pull
abilities.text: Pull every item and XP orb within 16 blocks into orbit around you. 15 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Mass Drop
abilities.text: Drop straight down at great speed, breaking soft blocks below. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Ground Breaker
abilities.text: Break a 3x3 area of soft blocks in front. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.text: Allies within 6 can't be knocked back for 10 s. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Saturn's Ring
abilities.text: A ring of debris orbits you, blocking projectiles for 6 s. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Weight Throw
abilities.text: Throw an ally or animal 10 blocks safely. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Star Light
abilities.text: Light a 10-block area for 2 minutes. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Star Rage
abilities.text: Your next hit carries huge mass: 2x damage and a big knockback. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.text: Open a small black hole for 4 s that pulls enemies in and deals 2 damage a second. 5 min cooldown.

desc: One clap and two things trade places. They fight like a shell game and never stand where you expect.

effects.name: Shell Game
effects.text: After you teleport, mobs lose track of you for 1 s.

effects.name: Hype
effects.text: Kills give Speed I for 5 s.

abilities.name: Clap Swap
abilities.text: Swap places with the creature you look at (24 blocks). 20 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Item Swap
abilities.text: Swap places with a dropped item or arrow you look at. 15 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Ally Rescue
abilities.text: Swap an ally with yourself from anywhere within 32 blocks. 60 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Swap Two
abilities.text: Swap two creatures you've marked within 24 blocks. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Feint Clap
abilities.text: Clap without swapping: mobs within 8 blocks are confused for 2 s. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Anchor Point
abilities.text: Mark a spot; clap to swap with it within 2 minutes. 2 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Mob Shuffle
abilities.text: Swap the places of every mob within 8 blocks at random. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Best Friend
abilities.text: Mark an ally: you always see where they are, for 20 minutes. 20 min cooldown.

abilities.name: Boulder Swap
abilities.text: Swap with a block you look at (up to 16 blocks), placing it where you stood. 30 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Stance
abilities.text: For 10 s you can't be knocked back and your punches knock back hard. 90 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Clap Strike
abilities.text: Swap behind the enemy you look at and hit it for 150% damage. 45 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Brother's Combo
abilities.text: Swap an ally behind an enemy: both your next hits deal 30% more. 90 s cooldown.
